title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
abstract: arXiv:2604.02715v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become mainstream for scaling language models to hundreds of billions of expert parameters. Despite sparse expert activation, existing inference engines keep all experts GPU-resident, crowding out the key-value cache in large-batch, long-output offline workloads. We present FluxMoE, which decouples experts from physical GPU residency and adapts their footprint to available memory through a new \emph{expert paging} abstraction. FluxMoE combines PagedTensor for transparent remapping, a bandwidth-balanced hierarchy spanning losslessly compressed GPU memory and host DRAM, and a budget-aware residency planner. Unlike CPU-GPU co-inference and whole-layer offloading, FluxMoE streams weights on demand while keeping expert computation on GPUs. We implement FluxMoE atop vLLM and evaluate it on three MoE models. For GLM-4.5 on 8$\times$H20 GPUs, FluxMoE delivers up to 7.2$\times$ vLLM's throughput and 79.0\%

translated_title: FluxMoE：解耦专家驻留以实现高性能MoE服务
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型已成为将语言模型扩展到数千亿专家参数规模的主流方法。尽管专家激活是稀疏的，现有推理引擎仍将所有专家保留在GPU显存中，在大批量、长输出的离线工作负载中挤占了键值缓存的存储空间。我们提出了FluxMoE，它将专家与物理GPU驻留解耦，并通过一种全新的“专家分页”抽象使专家的内存占用自适应于可用显存。FluxMoE结合了三个核心组件：用于透明重映射的PagedTensor、跨越无损压缩GPU内存与主机DRAM的带宽均衡层次结构，以及预算感知的驻留规划器。与CPU-GPU协同推理和整层卸载方案不同，FluxMoE按需流式传输权重，同时将专家计算保留在GPU上执行。我们在vLLM之上实现了FluxMoE，并在三个MoE模型上进行了评估。在8×H20 GPU上运行GLM-4.5时，FluxMoE的吞吐量最高达到vLLM的7.2倍，达到79.0%……
tldr: FluxMoE提出专家分页抽象，将MoE专家权重与GPU物理驻留解耦，在保持专家计算于GPU执行的同时按需流式传输权重，使大批量长输出场景下的吞吐量最高达到vLLM的7.2倍。
en_tdlr: FluxMoE introduces an expert paging abstraction that decouples MoE expert weights from physical GPU residency, streaming weights on demand while keeping expert computation on GPUs, achieving up to 7.2× vLLM's throughput in large-batch, long-output workloads.
